start_los_audit.scope: demonstration start generation only; never teacher action inputs
start_los_audit.method: joint proposal rejection sampling; redraw cargo and robot poses within the existing map/zone/strata and assignment rules

distribution.crate_axis: zone long side (y) or across it (x), +-8 deg, both facings

criteria.grasp_lift: both bilateral >=0.5 N, crate lowest point >= 12 mm, tilt <= 10 deg for >= 3 s
criteria.release: landing rectangle inside the zone, z < 0.05, no finger contact, speed < 0.01 m/s, tilt < 3 deg, both grippers open (>=1900) and grip site >= 4 cm from the crate axis segment, for 2 s
criteria.denominators: grasp_lift N=40; release counted over held episodes and over all 40

start_los_mass_scope: LOS static kinematics/rays used original 0.30 kg transform; only mass differs at 0.25 kg, geometry/camera/appearance unchanged
